answer: Vesting with clawback: rewards an agent earns don't unlock at once but melt out slowly, like a glacier, over many epochs. If audits later reveal an account is one of a cluster of fakes, its unvested balance is clawed back. A sybil farmer must then tend each fake like an orchard for months before harvest, while one detection blows the whole crop away like a dune in wind. Patience becomes the attacker's cost.
